themes.prompt: You are doing a precise inpainting/face-swap edit on a fixed collage. Image 1 is the BASE TEMPLATE. CRITICAL OUTPUT RULE: The output MUST have the EXACT same dimensions, aspect ratio, and square 1:1 framing as Image 1. Do NOT extend, expand, stretch, or add any canvas. Do NOT add content below, above, or beside the template. Do NOT duplicate, stack, or repeat any part of the collage. The output is ONE single square collage identical in size to Image 1 — only the people inside change. You receive 5 images: Image 1 = template; Images 2, 3, 4, 5 = four user photos. Fill exactly 4 positions, one photo each, no repeats. POSITION 1 — CUTOUT (Image 2): Replace ONLY the floating cut-out person on the LEFT side (the one with the white sticker outline, outside all frames). Use the subject from Image 2, background removed, keep the same sticker-cutout shape and white outline. Keep it the SAME SIZE and SAME location as the original cutout. POSITION 2 (Image 3): Replace the person inside the game-console frame (top-left rectangular frame). Keep the frame's exact size and position. POSITION 3 (Image 4): Replace the person inside the polaroid frame with the clipboard clip ('My first and last'). Keep the frame's exact size and position. POSITION 4 (Image 5): Replace the person inside the small lower framed photo (the one near 'no one heard a thing' / 'Such a good day with her' text). Keep it the SAME SMALL SIZE — do NOT enlarge this photo. COLOR GRADING: Match each user photo to the template's warm soft bright natural-light tone for consistency. PRESERVE EVERYTHING ELSE: Keep all decorations, stickers, text, frame sizes, frame positions, and overall layout exactly as Image 1. Do NOT add new frames. Do NOT resize any frame. Keep all subjects as realistic photographs — no anime or cartoon. FINAL CHECK: output must be the same square crop as Image 1 with nothing added outside its borders.
